verdict.rationale: Asana publishes an official OpenAPI specification (asana_oas.yaml plus app-components spec) in the Asana/openapi GitHub repo, which is machine-readable and downloadable, and the REST API docs corroborate a resource-oriented JSON API with in-context explorer built from this spec. Missing for 10: a directly hosted openapi.json/swagger.json endpoint on developers.asana.com (probe found 404s at expected discovery URLs), so users must know to fetch it from GitHub rather than a standard API-discovery path.
